build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter index map
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models from a list of word pieces
compose_word_decomposition: compose a word graph with a lexicon graph to compute all valid word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs for sequence alignment
calculate_sequence_loss: calculate sequence level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graphs and computing forward scores
